bug_summary: クレジットカード正規表現が14桁以上しか許容せず、13桁の正当な Visa カード番号を誤って拒否していた
pr_title: Adjust minimum digit count in credit card regex
pr_description: Raises the lower bound for the plain digit-sequence branch of CREDIT_CARD_REGEX from 13 to 14 digits, aligning it with the digit counts used by the grouped and hyphenated branches.
